import Mathlib

theorem rmo_2000_2
  (x y : ℕ)
  (hx : 0 < x)
  (hy : 0 < y)
  (h : y ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8) :
  x = 9 ∧ y = 11 := by
  have h₁ : y > x := by
    by_contra h'
    have h₂ : y ≤ x := by linarith
    have h₃ : y ^ 3 ≤ x ^ 3 := by
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_left h₂ 3
    have h₄ : x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 > x ^ 3 := by
      have h₅ : 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 > 0 := by
        cases x with
        | zero => contradiction
        | succ x' =>
          simp [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib]
          ring_nf
          omega
      omega
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : y ≤ x + 2 := by
    by_contra h'
    have h₃ : y ≥ x + 3 := by omega
    have h₄ : y ^ 3 ≥ (x + 3) ^ 3 := by
      exact Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le_left h₃ 3
    have h₅ : (x + 3) ^ 3 = x ^ 3 + 9 * x ^ 2 + 27 * x + 27 := by
      ring
    have h₆ : x ^ 3 + 9 * x ^ 2 + 27 * x + 27 > x ^ 3 + 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
      have h₇ : x ^ 2 + 33 * x + 19 > 0 := by
        nlinarith
      omega
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : y = x + 1 ∨ y = x + 2 := by
    have h₄ : y > x := h₁
    have h₅ : y ≤ x + 2 := h₂
    omega
  
  rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃)
  · -- Case y = x + 1
    rw [h₃] at h
    ring_nf at h
    have h₄ : x = 9 := by
      have h₅ : 3 * x ^ 2 + 3 * x + 1 = 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
        omega
      have h₆ : 5 * x ^ 2 - 9 * x + 7 = 0 := by
        omega
      have h₇ : x ≤ 9 := by
        by_contra h'
        have h₈ : x ≥ 10 := by omega
        have h₉ : 5 * x ^ 2 - 9 * x + 7 > 0 := by
          nlinarith
        omega
      interval_cases x <;> norm_num at h₆ ⊢ <;> omega
    have h₅ : y = 11 := by
      rw [h₃, h₄]
      <;> norm_num
    exact ⟨h₄, h₅⟩
  · -- Case y = x + 2
    rw [h₃] at h
    ring_nf at h
    have h₄ : x = 9 := by
      have h₅ : 6 * x ^ 2 + 12 * x + 8 = 8 * x ^ 2 - 6 * x + 8 := by
        omega
      have h₆ : 2 * x ^ 2 - 18 * x = 0 := by
        omega
      have h₇ : x * (x - 9) = 0 := by
        omega
      have h₈ : x = 0 ∨ x = 9 := by
        have h₉ : x = 0 ∨ x - 9 = 0 := by
          apply eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero h₇
        cases h₉ with
        | inl h₉ => exact Or.inl h₉
        | inr h₉ => exact Or.inr (by omega)
      cases h₈ with
      | inl h₈ =>
        exfalso
        linarith
      | inr h₈ =>
        exact h₈
    have h₅ : y = 11 := by
      rw [h₃, h₄]
      <;> norm_num
    exact ⟨h₄, h₅⟩
